earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: Net income: $758 million, $828 million excluding identified items
Diluted earnings per share: $2.32 per share, $2.54 per share excluding identified items
The company reported net income for the third quarter 2026 of $758 million, or $2.32 per diluted share.

quotes.text: In an evolving macroeconomic environment, we delivered another quarter of strong earnings and robust cash conversion through disciplined execution underscored by the strength of our global, cost-advantaged portfolio.
quotes.by: Peter Vanacker, LYB chief executive officer

items.heading: The cyclicality and volatility of the industries in which we participate may cause significant fluctuations in our operating results.
items.group: Risks Related to our Business and Industry

items.heading: A sustained decrease in the price of crude oil may adversely impact the results of our operations, primarily in North America.
items.group: Risks Related to our Business and Industry

items.heading: Costs and limitations on supply of raw materials and energy may result in increased operating expenses.
items.group: Risks Related to our Business and Industry

items.heading: Our ability to source raw materials or deliver products may be adversely affected by political instability, civil disturbances or other governmental actions.

Our business is capital intensive and we rely on cash generated from operations and external financing to fund our growth, dividends, and ongoing capital needs. Limitations on access to external financing could adversely affect our operating results.
Our operations are subject to risks inherent in the chemical industry, and we could be subject to liabilities for which we are not fully insured or that are not otherwise mitigated.
